_note: DRAFT Gĩkũyũ (Kikuyu) translation of en.json — written without a native speaker and NOT yet reviewed. Must be checked by a Gĩkũyũ-speaking agronomist or extension officer before use with farmers; set "reviewed": true in catalog.json once done. Disease and product names (rust, Phoma, copper, neem) are kept in English, as farmers and agro-dealers commonly use them.
coffee_leaf_rust: Mũrimũ wa rust nĩ wonekete mathangũ-inĩ ma kahũa gaku. Mũrimũ ũyũ ũhurunjũkaga narua hĩndĩ ya mbura. Ĩka ũndũ thĩinĩ wa mĩthenya ĩtatũ. Tinia honge iria irĩ na mũrimũ mũno, ũcicine na mwaki. Thutha ũcio, hũhĩria mathangũ marĩa matigarĩte ndawa ya copper, na wĩke ũguo rĩngĩ o thutha wa ciumia igĩrĩ hĩndĩ ya mbura. Ũngĩtiga kũwĩka ũguo, magetha maku no manyihe nginya nuthu.
coffee_leaf_miner: Tũgunyũ tũnini nĩ tũrĩĩte mathangũ thĩinĩ. Ũrĩ na kiumia kĩmwe mbere ya mũrimũ ũyũ kũhurunjũka. Ruta mathangũ marĩa marĩ na ũgwati ũmacine. Thutha ũcio, hũhĩria ndawa ya neem rũciinĩ tene, na ũrore mĩtĩ ĩrĩa ĩrĩ hakuhĩ.
coffee_phoma: Mũrimũ wa Phoma nĩ wonekete. Mũrimũ ũyũ ũgĩĩaga thutha wa heho na mbura. Ruta mathangũ marĩa marĩ na mathunjĩ, na ũtinie honge nĩguo rũhuho rũtoonyage mũtĩ-inĩ. Hũhĩria ndawa ya copper, na ndũkaitĩrĩrie maaĩ mathangũ-igũrũ. Rora rĩngĩ thutha wa kiumia, na ũrie mũrutani wa ũrĩmi mũrimũ ũngĩhurunjũka.
coffee_brown_eye: Mũrimũ wa brown eye nĩ wonekete. Kaingĩ ũyũ nĩ kuuga mũtĩ ũrĩ na ngʼaragu ya irio, mũno nitrogen kana potassium. Ambĩrĩria kũhe mĩtĩ mbolea njega. Mathunjĩ mangĩthiĩ na mbere kũingĩha, hũhĩria ndawa ya copper. Ũyũ ti wa ihenya mũno, no thondeka ũndũ wa irio narua.
healthy: Mũtĩ waku wonekaga ũrĩ mũgima — gũtirĩ mũrimũ wonekete. Thiĩ na mbere: rora mathangũ thutha wa mbura, ũheage mĩtĩ mbolea, na ũtinie honge iria nyingĩ. Cooka ũthime rĩngĩ thutha wa mĩthenya mĩnini.
unknown: Mbica ĩno ndĩrĩ njega ya kũmenya mũrimũ wega. Oya mbica ya ithangũ rĩmwe ũrĩ hakuhĩ, ĩrĩ na ũtheri mwega wa mũthenya, na mathunjĩ makĩonekaga. Mũrimũ ũngĩoneka ta ũrĩ mũnene, ũria mũrutani wa ũrĩmi mbere ya kũhũhĩria ndawa o yothe.
